faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about AgriConnect.
faq.q1Answer: Yes. AgriConnect is completely free for farmers. Listing your produce, browsing buyers and using daily market prices costs nothing.
faq.q2: How do I verify my account?
faq.q2Answer: You verify your account with a simple OTP sent to your mobile number. This keeps the marketplace safe and trustworthy.
faq.q3Answer: AgriConnect is available in English, Gujarati and Hindi, with more Indian languages on the way.
faq.q4Answer: Payment is agreed directly between you and the buyer. You can accept cash, UPI or bank transfer as convenient.
faq.q5Answer: Only your village and district are shown to buyers. Your exact address and mobile number stay private and secure.

what.question: What is AgriConnect?
what.answer: AgriConnect is an agricultural marketplace and resource app for exploring crop listings, buyer requirements, market prices, crop guides, and government schemes.

browse.question: Can I browse listings without signing in?
browse.answer: Yes. Marketplace listings, market prices, crop guides, schemes, buyer requirements, and transport listings can be browsed publicly. Sign in for protected account actions.

list.question: How do I list my crops?
list.answer: Sign in, open the Marketplace, and choose the option to create a listing. You need an account to create or manage listings.

prices.question: Can I view market prices without signing in?
prices.answer: Yes. Market price information is available to browse without signing in.

requirements.question: Where can I find buyer requirements?
requirements.answer: Browse active requests from the Buyer Requirement page. Sign in to post or manage your own buyer requirements.

languages.question: Which languages can I use?
languages.answer: AgriConnect is available in English, Hindi, and Gujarati. Choose a language from the header.

transport.question: Can I browse transport listings without signing in?
transport.answer: Yes. You can browse active transport provider listings publicly. Sign in to create or manage your own transport listing.

contact.question: Do I need to sign in to see contact details?
contact.answer: Yes. Sign in to view personal contact details for buyer requirements and transport providers.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about AgriConnect.
faq.q1Answer: Yes. AgriConnect is completely free for farmers. Listing your produce, browsing buyers and using daily market prices costs nothing.
faq.q2: How do I verify my account?
faq.q2Answer: You verify your account with a simple OTP sent to your mobile number. This keeps the marketplace safe and trustworthy.
faq.q3Answer: AgriConnect is available in English, Gujarati and Hindi, with more Indian languages on the way.
faq.q4Answer: Payment is agreed directly between you and the buyer. You can accept cash, UPI or bank transfer as convenient.
faq.q5Answer: Only your village and district are shown to buyers. Your exact address and mobile number stay private and secure.
